details: Windows 1.0.77 COM3: "Icom identify (10 bytes) | echo only". The attached image is our CS-41S sample (SHA-256 eb3dd05b...), not the radio. CS-41S user manual: connect the cable to [SP] first, then power on with [VOL]; NewChirp prompts said the opposite order. Prompts fixed; ask the owner to retry in that order.
summary: First physical read: cable echoes the identify frame, radio silent
